known_rules.symptom: Adding a complete prototype can renumber GCC static symbols and swap adjacent independent register clears in an unrelated unresolved function.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Historical GCC declaration UID changes from a prototype-only edit.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Do not edit the affected function body to undo the change. The interface gate checks decoded independent clears, entry points, all other bytes and allocated contributions. Original matching remains byte-exact.

known_rules.symptom: A bounded window contains exactly the same decoded MOV or register-clear instructions in a different order.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Adjacent assignment order or expression evaluation may affect instruction scheduling. The permutation alone does not establish the source cause or instruction independence.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Use candidate line mappings and the generated adjacent-assignment experiment when present. Verify the entire function; changes to other windows, operands or peeled iterations still fail acceptance.
